title: REMAIN CALM Part 2: Breathe In A Box | The Dead Smell Fear
description:
What if one slow breath could make you invisible to the dead?

A baby is crying, the dead are closing in, and the only weapon at FRESHWAY 24H is box breathing: in for 4, hold for 4, out for 4, hold for 4.

🧠 Real tip: box breathing is a slow-breathing pattern used to stay calm under stress. Try it for a minute next time you are nervous.
